place: a dark studio stage, a cut-open car engine block towering over a hand-sized starter motor bolted at its base

moments.what: the starter motor's armature already spinning inside its cut-open case, its name labelled
a second line on its label says it fits in your hand
the ring gear's teeth light as the pinion turns it
the camera pulls back to the whole engine block towering over it, pistons rising and falling
the cylinders flash amber as the engine catches

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: This hand-sized motor starts a whole car engine.

place: the ignition slot on a dark dashboard
inside the solenoid, cut in half

moments.what: the car key turns in the ignition slot
a glowing current runs from the key along a wire
cut to the solenoid on the motor's back, sliced open, its label writing on
its copper coil glows as the current arrives
the steel plunger slams into the coil
a label writes on the plunger

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Turn the key, and the solenoid, an electromagnet, snaps its plunger in.

place: the starter's nose, cut away, beside the flywheel's edge

moments.what: the plunger pulls the top of the fork lever back
the lever pivots, its label writing on
the lever's foot pushes the pinion along the shaft
close on the small pinion gear, labelled
the pinion's teeth slide in between the ring gear's teeth, which light amber
the camera pulls back to the whole flywheel with the pinion meshed at its rim

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: That pulls a lever, shoving the pinion gear into the toothed ring on the flywheel.

place: the solenoid's back end, its contact cap cut open
the car battery and the motor's thick cable

moments.what: the plunger slides the last few millimetres
its copper disc slams across the two contact posts with a spark
the contacts are labelled
the battery's terminals light up
a thick glowing current rushes along the heavy cable
the current pours into the motor's windings
the armature starts to spin hard

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The plunger then bridges two copper contacts, and battery current floods the motor.

place: a dark workbench under a lamp, the pinion and the ring gear side by side at their true sizes

moments.what: the motor strains against a still ring gear, nothing moves
the starter's case glows warning red as it strains
the ring gear shudders but does not turn
the stuck gear teeth flash red
a red stop bar flashes across the stuck gears
close on the pinion, its teeth lighting one by one, the count on a tag
the last tooth lights
the camera pulls back across the huge ring gear, its teeth lighting round the rim, its count on a tag
the lit wave of teeth closes the circle round the ring

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But a motor this small can't turn an engine head-on. This pinion has 9 teeth. The ring has 135.

place: the engine's crankshaft and pistons, cut open, the starter meshed below them

moments.what: the starter and flywheel turn together in mesh
the pinion whirls at the flywheel's rim, the motor's windings glowing
a turn counter beside the pinion starts counting
the flywheel's glowing marker appears on its rim
the marker creeps round with the flywheel
the flywheel's marker completes one full turn while the counter lands on the figure
a speed arrow on the pinion shrinks as a force arrow on the flywheel grows
the camera pulls back as the crankshaft turns and the pistons slide up and down
the pistons are labelled
the crank throws swing round in a glowing arc

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So the pinion spins 15.0× for each turn of the engine, trading speed for force to drag the pistons round.

place: inside a cylinder at the moment of the spark
the pinion's one-way clutch, sliced open, in front of the spinning flywheel

moments.what: the spark plug fires inside the cylinder in an amber flash and the piston slams down
cut to the clutch inside the pinion, its rollers labelled
the rollers slip back in their ramps
the pinion's outer ring starts to outrun the hub
the pinion spins free while the shaft behind it slows, the red fades
cut to the starter's nose, the solenoid's coil going dark as the key is let go
the plunger starts to slide back out of the dark coil
the return spring stretches out, labelled
the pinion slides back out of the ring gear, a clear gap opening

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Once the engine fires, a one-way clutch lets the pinion spin free. Let go of the key, and a spring pulls it back.

place: an early motor car's front in a dim old garage
the crank handle at the radiator

moments.what: an old open car with brass lamps rolls into a pool of light
an order slip stands up on the running board, the count written on it counting up
the order plate's count lands
a glowing starter motor appears under the car's bonnet
the light turns sepia
close on the crank handle at the radiator, swinging round
the handle swings round once more

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Cadillac ordered 12,000 of Kettering's electric starters. Before, you cranked engines by hand.

place: the dark studio stage, the starter motor at the base of the engine block

moments.what: a jet engine's fan glows in the dark to the left
the jet engine's fan spins up
a wind turbine's blades turn on the right
both fade as the camera glides back to the engine block
the engine block's cylinders light as the camera nears
the starter's pinion shoots forward again
the camera settles on the starter motor, framed as at the start
its armature spins, as in the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Jet engine or wind turbine next? When you turn the key, think of this motor.
